label: Important data: REM less unit billed
notes: A report sheet with merged headers, read by position (header: false). Office rows have the CCC code in column D; F = live consumers, I = bills under 10 units including zero, M = zero-unit bills (the labels important_sheets.html uses for I56 and M56); the title in column A holds the billing schedule. Read by lib/rating_metrics.js (low_unit_bill_share).
